rule: Personal chat, coordination or an invitation to talk, without an account-security demand.
A short factual assertion about a political actor, funding, policy or public institution; no extended news narrative.
A reported public event or news narrative, including event-linked social posts; excludes standalone political assertions.
An account warning explicitly requests credentials or passwords; this rule takes priority over conversational wording.
A first-person product endorsement reports satisfaction, features or performance.
